name: pi-mcp-ui
description: MCP UI server that wraps the pi coding agent in an interactive chat GUI (mcp-ui + MCP Apps tracks)

scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build:server && npm run build:dev
scripts.dev: npm run build:widget && npm run build:dev && tsx src/dev/dev-server.ts
scripts.inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node dist/server.js
